_title: XGRA: Extreme G Racing Association (0x41430014), XDK 5558
_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, the video library, so these
addresses had no names and could not be replaced by name.
scripts/section_calls.py finds eight calls crossing into the XMV section
CreateAudioStream sit at Future Perfect's offsets into the section
(+0x10D, +0x651, +0x735, +0x7A2); the rest are named from how the movie
code at 0x00098C60..0x000997C0 calls them. The eighth, 0x000D975A, takes
two callbacks and creates a playback that is fed packets by the title; it
is left to the XDK, and the replacements hand a playback they did not
make back to the XDK's own bodies. See docs/technical/video-playback.md.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x000D9BC2, from 0x00099476: (handle, 0, 0, 0, NULL) -- XGRA passes no output slot.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackReleaseAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x000D9D41, from 0x000997EB before Destroy: (handle, index) clears slot index of the stream array at the playback's +0x138 and sets +0x130 to -1.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackStopAudioStreams
symbols._note: 0x000D9D62, from 0x00098C7E, 0x00098DF6, 0x00098E09 and 0x000997D5: walks the playback's audio streams at +0x134 and calls a method on each.
